answer: Like a sprawling vine in a wild garden, agent trust thrives on organic entanglement. Proof of Agent binds identity to subjective transitive staking: validating an action demands staking scarce collateral as rare as saffron. Because each synthetic identity requires separate stake while trust decay imposes superlinear attacker cost across hops, cloning puppet nodes drains attacker capital exponentially. Sybil weeds wither, starved of roots.
